negative_findings.description: I found no free, standalone official web portal for «Офіційний вісник України» itself. The gazette is founded by the Ministry of Justice and published by ДП «Українська правова інформація»; its issues are distributed as a paid print/CD/online subscription via ДП «Преса» (indices 40433 and 48345). No 'ovu.gov.ua' style official free full-text site surfaced in Ukrainian-language searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Authoritative gazette text is a paid product; the free authoritative substitute for publication dates is the zakon.rada.gov.ua b19 publication index plus the Minjust register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A3 deadline tracking depends on the publication timestamp. If verbatim gazette text is ever required for legal certainty, budget and licensing must be planned; otherwise the pipeline must rely on the rada/Minjust surrogates and label them as such.

negative_findings.description: A WebFetch of https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/laws/main/b19 (the gazette publication index) returned a 'socket hang up'. This is a connection-level failure consistent with bot defence, not evidence that the page is dead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Page treated as live-but-defended and unverified; the URL is recorded with reduced confidence, not dropped.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important free source in this cell may need a headless browser or realistic headers to collect; the collection design should assume that from the start.

negative_findings.description: Seed-adjacent searching for a single Ukrainian government-wide consultation portal (an equivalent of a 'regulation.gov.ua') did not surface one. Draft regulatory acts are instead published decentrally: each ministry runs its own 'Повідомлення про оприлюднення проєктів регуляторних актів' page, with ДРС (drs.gov.ua) acting as the oversight and digest layer.
negative_findings.result_summary: No single consultation aggregator identified; coverage must be assembled per-ministry plus the DRS digest.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A3 consultation-deadline tracking cannot rely on one endpoint; the collector needs a per-ministry registry of consultation feeds.

negative_findings.description: I found no documented public API returning gazette issue contents or official publication dates as structured data. The parliament's open data portal (data.rada.gov.ua) offers XML/JSON/TXT legislation bundles and data.gov.ua carries a Minjust register dataset, but neither was confirmed to expose an issue-by-issue gazette feed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk open-data exports exist; a purpose-built gazette API does not appear to.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Publication-date extraction will require parsing act cards or bulk datasets rather than a clean API, raising maintenance cost and staleness risk.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching against the Cabinet of Ministers and Ministry of Finance produced only a partial EN mirror (kmu.gov.ua/en/npasearch, /en/news) and no English gazette. Official English texts of CMU resolutions and MinFin orders were not found.
negative_findings.result_summary: English is a navigation aid only in this cell; all substantive collection must be Ukrainian-language.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any downstream English-only analysis of Ukrainian executive acts would be operating on unofficial renderings; translation must be an explicit pipeline step with provenance kept.

coverage_gaps.description: I identified several candidate carriers of the official publication date (zakon.rada b19 index, act cards' 'Опублiковано' field, reestrnpa 'Опублікування в офіційних виданнях'), but did not confirm end-to-end which one gives a reliably complete, machine-parseable date for CMU resolutions and MinFin orders specifically.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted resolution test: take 10 known banking/payments CMU and MinFin acts and attempt to recover the gazette issue and date from each candidate carrier; pick the carrier with the highest recall as canonical and the others as fallbacks.

coverage_gaps.description: MinFin's own 'проєкти регуляторних актів' / 'громадське обговорення' page was not directly located in this run — I confirmed the pattern only on Мінекономіки and МОН.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search site-restricted on mof.gov.ua for 'проєкти регуляторних актів', 'обговорення', 'регуляторна політика' and register the resulting URL as a first-class consultation feed.

coverage_gaps.description: MinFin acts as shareholder of the state banks, but the corresponding corporate-side disclosures (Ощадбанк, Укрексімбанк, Укргазбанк, Приватбанк supervisory board and governance announcements) were not scouted here — they sit at the edge of this cell and may belong to another.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm with the run owner whether state bank issuer disclosures belong to cell #5 or another cell; if here, scout each bank's official disclosure section in Ukrainian.

coverage_gaps.description: Decrees of the President (укази Президента України) are also published in the gazette and can bear on financial-sector governance and martial-law-era payment measures, but the president.gov.ua act channel was not scouted in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a pass over president.gov.ua/documents with banking/payments keyword filters, joined to the same gazette publication-date resolution.

coverage_gaps.description: Wartime practice may alter normal publication and entry-into-force rules (e.g. acts entering force on the day of publication on the government portal rather than gazette issue). I did not verify whether such deviations are currently in effect.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and read the governing law on the procedure for entry into force of acts (and any martial-law amendments) and encode the current rule set into the deadline calculator rather than assuming peacetime rules.

coverage_gaps.description: The licensing and redistribution terms of the paid «Офіційний вісник України» online/CD editions from ДП «Українська правова інформація» were not obtained.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Contact the publisher's sales channel (listed on the subscription pages) for institutional licensing and machine-access terms before any ingestion of paid gazette content.

brief: Ukraine's publication-of-record layer is split across three official vehicles — «Офіційний вісник України» (Minjust-founded, published by ДП «Українська правова інформація», commercially distributed and with no free official full-text site), «Урядовий кур'єр» (executive branch daily, freely readable online), and «Голос України» (parliament) — with the Ministry of Justice's Єдиний державний реєстр НПА and the Rada's ІПС «Законодавство України» publication indices acting as the free, machine-reachable surrogates for the authoritative publication timestamp that A3 deadlines run from. On the act-origination side, the Cabinet's npas repository, the Ministry of Finance's per-year наказ indices and its 'банки державного сектору' section, and the State Treasury's накази together carry the binding banking/payments acts — cashless-settlement obligations for merchants, state bank governance, treasury payment procedures — that never appear on NBU channels. The pre-adoption stage is decentralised: there is no single national consultation portal, so draft regulatory acts must be picked up from each ministry's 'повідомлення про оприлюднення' feed with Державна регуляторна служба acting as the oversight and digest layer. Principal risks for collection are bot defences on zakon.rada.gov.ua (one fetch returned a socket hang up — hypothesis, not a verdict), the paywalled gazette itself, and the legacy Lotus Domino interface of the Minjust register, for which the Data.gov.ua open-data export is the preferred workaround.
